runs.name: Velo3D, Inc.
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$7.99** (close 2026-10-12, aggregator quote printed by `tools/run.py`, flagged). Shares **32,149,118**, one class (10-Q cover at 2026-08-07, acc 0001193125-26-344560, `Screens/cover_shares.py`; equal to issued and outstanding at 2026-06-30, no treasury shares; an at-the-market program of $100.0M with $59.4M sold by 2026-06-30 may have sold shares after the cover date, an open item); cap **$256.9M**. Reverse splits 1-for-35 (2024-06-13) and 1-for-15 (2025-07-28). Sovereign **5.60%** (USD; Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-09). Filings read: the FY2025 10-K (0001193125-26-134997), the June 2026 10-Q, the DEF 14A of 2026-04-27 (0001825079-26-000007), the 8-Ks of 2026-08-11, 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-09, and the FY2021 to FY2024 10-Ks for the balance sheets. One figure cross-checked: operating cash FY2025 $(27,327) thousand on the filed cash-flow statement, equal to the `tools/run.py` line. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7. Competitors: none of five 10-Ks (FY2021 to FY2025) names a rival, so none read or flagged. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: metal additive manufacturing systems and production services, a technology the filer says is "undergoing technological advancements across hardware, software and materials" and whose products "may be rendered obsolete or uneconomical"; the shift to production printing stated as the company's belief; revenue 19.0, 27.4, 78.7, 77.4, 41.0, 46.0 ($M, 2020 to 2025), gross margin from +33.6% to (33.9)% to (16.1)%; the model changing toward the in-house service with $40M to $50M of 2026 capital spending and a 124-month campus lease; ten-year economics and the field's winner not foreseeable and no filing would state them. Contrary evidence weighed at Q1: second-quarter 2026 revenue up 52.3%, gross margin 21.5%, backlog $31M, 2026 guidance raised to $65M to $75M. The start-up rows considered and not applied (eleven years old with filed revenue), said so. Q2 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash negative in every year 2020 to 2025, five-year mean -$86.0M before interest, -$88.8M after; range **-$45.21 a share** (no-growth case alone, all-equity, net cash $83.0M added; equity-only -$49.32) against $7.99; no case earns the floor at any positive price; fair **-$24.18** all-equity, -$27.62 equity-only, no positive figure; no alert. Balance sheets 2020 to June 2026: paid-in capital $15.0M to $663.2M, accumulated deficit $122.8M to $516.7M, cash down to $1.2M at end 2024 and rebuilt by share issues, share count up about ninety-fold since end 2021 on today's basis; going-concern doubt stated in the 10-K and again in the June 2026 10-Q with $91.1M of cash; material weaknesses unremediated since the FY2023 10-K; FY2022 revenue and FY2024 stock pay revised. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: the chief executive controls about 48.6% through the entity that bought the defaulted secured notes and exchanged them for about 95% of the company in December 2024, and runs Arrayed Additive in the same field; 3,000,000 of his shares pledged; a director's entities held the 2025 convertible notes whose conversion prices were cut, and one is co-lessee on the sale-leaseback; the interim CFO furnished by the company's outside accounting firm after the CFO left 2026-09-28; guidance restated on the chief executive's personal X account; a 2026 margin gain attributed in part to a refinement in cost allocation. Contamination declared by the analyst: names of other 2026-10-13 run files in one directory listing, TPICQ commit subjects, AYI and ARCB folder names in the git status, memory lines on queue state; none names Velo3D; nothing used. Commits 5480d616, e3ccb0ab, ece81722. Citations: the analyst's check PASS; the dispatcher's script (`dispatcher_quote_check.py`) found 17 fragments, none unmatched, every id in the ledger, no E-id. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) the range convention has no instruction for a stream negative in every year, so the range, the width test and the fair price collapse to one negative figure; (2) the brief's competitor rule returns nothing when the 10-K names no rival; (3) "start-up" in Q1's OUT list is undefined, so another analyst could close the same file OUT at Q1 rather than TOO HARD. Could not get: a share count after 2026-08-07; the 2019 balance sheet in the 2021 merger filing.
runs.narr: Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): a metal 3D-printing maker (Sapphire systems and Rapid Production Solutions services) in a technology the filer itself says may render its products obsolete; revenue 19.0 to 78.7 to 46.0 ($M, 2020 to 2025), gross margin negative 2023 to 2025, owner cash negative every filed year, going-concern doubt still stated with $91.1M of cash; ten-year economics and winner not foreseeable; the 2026 upturn (revenue up 52.3% in Q2, guidance $65M to $75M) weighed at Q1. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range -$45.21 a share all-equity against $7.99, fair -$24.18 all-equity (-$27.62 equity-only), no positive figure, not armed. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: the chief executive controls about 48.6% through the buyer of the defaulted notes and runs a same-field company; pledged shares; director-held convertibles repriced; interim CFO from the outside accounting firm.
